summary: Beat Saber entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Beat Saber
entries.definitive_edition: Current SteamVR build for capture; Meta Quest as the standalone route

emulation.notes: Use native VR platform builds; do not treat unofficial sideloads or custom songs as the canonical route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC VR headset and capture hardware/settings

primary.version: Current Beat Saber SteamVR build with active PC music library documented
primary.why: SteamVR remains a current supported PC route, keeps the strongest capture/settings flexibility, and avoids the PlayStation branch where new content stopped after June 18, 2025 and multiplayer is unavailable from February 26, 2026.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current SteamVR build on a PC VR headset. Record game version, headset/controllers, tracking setup, refresh rate, modifiers, official music/DLC installed, custom-song/mod state if any, and whether Quest or PlayStation content was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if cable-free VR convenience matters more than PC capture control.
secondary.why: Quest is a current first-party standalone route, but PC is easier to capture at high quality.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for already-owned PlayStation content or headset comparison.
secondary.why: Official Beat Saber FAQ says PlayStation stopped receiving new content after June 18, 2025 and multiplayer is no longer available there from February 26, 2026.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact music pack/DLC entitlements, custom-song/mod state, headset, and PlayStation sunset caveat when comparing platforms.
